name: barbell single arm biceps curl
description: A standing single-arm curl with a short barbell. It trains the biceps and grip control.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a short barbell in one hand, palm facing forward.
Keep the elbow near your side and curl the barbell toward your shoulder without swinging your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower the barbell slowly.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch hands.
